question: A sanitizer runs on user HTML, but a mutation-XSS payload survives when the output is re-parsed inside an xmp wrapper. Which pack covers the browser-side sanitizer parsing differential?
The same multipart body is interpreted differently by a WAF and the backend, and a filename parameter containing CR becomes a separate part upstream. Which pack covers this?
A search endpoint filters on a text field; sending the integer 0 in the filter returns every row. Which pack covers query-engine filter coercion and pagination leaks?
An upload accepts a polyglot that passes extension and magic-byte checks, and an ImageMagick pipeline renders it later. Which pack covers upload validation and image processing surfaces?
An exported Android activity forwards an attacker Intent into an internal WebView that exposes a JavaScript bridge. Which pack covers deep links, intents and WebView bridges?
A serverless function URL with auth set to NONE is reachable and the function assumes a role that can hit the instance metadata service. Which pack covers serverless and IAM surface?
A GitLab webhook uses a signing token, the pipeline caches artifacts between branches, and OIDC tokens are issued to pull requests. Which pack covers CI/CD trust boundaries?
A dangling SPF include lets an attacker send mail as the domain, and the password-reset email silently strips a plus-suffix. Which pack covers email and DNS takeover surfaces?
An MCP server changes its tool descriptions after approval (rug-pull) and a spawned subagent inherits the parent's full tool scopes. Which pack covers agentic and MCP trust boundaries?
A WebSocket handshake accepts a cross-site Origin and a channel is authorized only at connect time, not per message. Which pack covers realtime transports and subscription ACLs?
A Next.js Server Action is reachable through a middleware rewrite from an unauthenticated path. Which pack covers framework-generated surfaces and router manifests?
The JWKS still serves a previous key, an id_token arrives via an OIDC hybrid flow, and a magic link is reusable after login. Which pack covers token-library behavior and session lifecycle?
A GraphQL endpoint accepts a GET mutation when persisted queries are enabled, and gRPC metadata is transcoded by an Envoy gateway. Which pack covers API protocols and gateway translation?
A CDN normalizes the path before cache rules run, and a dangling-byte delta between two requests desynchronizes the origin parser. Which pack covers desync and cache-key behavior?
A refund race abuses HTTP/2 single-packet concurrency and the payment gateway's idempotency key is omitted on retry. Which pack covers workflow, race windows and payment semantics?
You observe a behavior no pack explains: a clean request mutates a previous response, and the spec is silent about it. Where do you record and harden a novel primitive?
An EIP-712 signature is replayable on a forked chain and a bridge accepts a message twice. Which pack covers wallet signatures, bridges and on-chain state?
A SvelteKit __data.json endpoint returns protected data when the route is requested with a case-variant path. Which pack covers the framework's generated data routes?
A reset link is not invalidated after use and an attacker pre-registers the victim's email to hijack the account merge. Which pack covers recovery chains and pre-hijacking?
A cross-origin page detects whether the victim is logged in by probing the HTTP cache with fetch and a timing oracle. Which pack covers XS-Leaks and cache probing?
